parameters.name: AlarmMetadata
parameters.description:
The alert configurations for the service.

> This configuration takes effect only after you configure an alert-related access policy for **PolicyNames**.

parameters.name: ApprovalType
parameters.description:
The approval type for service usage requests. Valid values:

- Manual: The request is manually approved.

- AutoPass: The request is automatically approved.

parameters.name: BuildParameters
parameters.description: The parameters for building the service.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent. You can use a client to generate the token. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Commodity
parameters.description: The commodity information.

parameters.name: ComplianceMetadata
parameters.description: The compliance check metadata.

parameters.name: DeployMetadata
parameters.description: The information about the service deployment configuration. The data format varies based on the deployment type. The value is a JSON string.

parameters.name: DeployType
parameters.description:
The deployment type. Valid values:

- ros: The service is deployed using ROS.

- terraform: The service is deployed using Terraform.

- spi: The service is deployed by calling an SPI.

- operation: The service is an O\&M service.

- container: The service is deployed using containers.

- pkg: The service is a package service.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for the request. A dry run checks the permissions and the instance status. Valid values:

- true: sends the request but does not update the service.

- false: sends the request. If the check is successful, the service is updated.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The O\&M duration. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: IsSupportOperated
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable O\&M. Default value: false. Valid values:

- true: enables O\&M.

- false: disables O\&M.

> This parameter is required when **ServiceType** is set to **private**.

parameters.name: LicenseMetadata
parameters.description: The license metadata.

parameters.name: LogMetadata
parameters.description: The application log configurations.

parameters.name: OperationMetadata
parameters.description: The O\&M configuration.

parameters.name: PolicyNames
parameters.description: The policy name. The name of a single policy can be up to 128 characters in length. If you specify multiple policies, separate them with commas (,). Only O\&M-related policies are supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: Resellable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable distribution. Valid values:

- false: Distribution is not enabled.

- true: Distribution is enabled.

parameters.name: ServiceId
parameters.description: The service ID.

parameters.name: ServiceInfo
parameters.description: The service details.

sub_parameters.name: Agreements
sub_parameters.description: The information about the service agreements.

sub_parameters.name: Image
sub_parameters.description: The URL of the service icon.

sub_parameters.name: Locale
sub_parameters.description:
The language of the service. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English.

sub_parameters.name: LongDescriptionUrl
sub_parameters.description: The URL of the detailed description of the service.

sub_parameters.name: Softwares
sub_parameters.description: The information about the software used in the service.

parameters.name: ServiceLocaleConfigs
parameters.description: The multilingual configurations of the service.

sub_parameters.name: EnValue
sub_parameters.description: The English value of the business information.

sub_parameters.name: OriginalValue
sub_parameters.description: The raw data value of the business information.

sub_parameters.name: ZhValue
sub_parameters.description: The Chinese value of the business information.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:

- private: The service instance is deployed in the user account.

- managed: The service instance is deployed in the service provider account.

- operation: The service instance is an O\&M instance.

- poc: The service instance is a trial instance.

parameters.name: ServiceVersion
parameters.description: The service version.

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description:
The sharing type. Valid values:

- Public: The service is public. Formal and trial deployments are not restricted.

- Restricted: The service is restricted. Formal and trial deployments are restricted.

- OnlyFormalRestricted: Only formal deployments are restricted.

- OnlyTrailRestricted: Only trial deployments are restricted.

- Hidden: The service is hidden. You cannot view the service or request deployment permissions.

parameters.name: TenantType
parameters.description:
The tenant type. Valid values:

- SingleTenant: The service is single-tenant.

- MultiTenant: The service is multi-tenant.

parameters.name: TrialDuration
parameters.description: The trial duration. Unit: days. The maximum trial duration is 30 days.

parameters.name: UpdateOption
parameters.description: The update options.

parameters.name: UpgradeMetadata
parameters.description: The upgrade metadata.

parameters.name: VersionName
parameters.description: The version name.
